function registerCredit(string projectName, address initialOwner, uint256 quantity, string documentHash) returns (uint256)

function getCredit(uint256 creditId) view returns (tuple(uint256 id,string projectName,address issuer,address owner,uint256 quantity,uint256 registeredAt,uint256 retiredAt,bool retired,string documentHash,string retirementPurpose))
function verifyOwnership(uint256 creditId, address account) view returns (bool)
event CreditRegistered(uint256 indexed creditId,address indexed issuer,address indexed owner,uint256 quantity,string projectName,string documentHash)
event CreditTransferred(uint256 indexed creditId,address indexed from,address indexed to)
event CreditRetired(uint256 indexed creditId,address indexed owner,uint256 quantity,string purpose,uint256 retiredAt)
